adaptations: Source folded shell split into spring spine and two source-mesh jaws.
Original wire handles kept as physical geometry rigidly attached to corresponding jaw.
Two revolute flexure approximations with constant opposing closing spring torque; free-floating base.
Per-source-part convex hulls retain the space between jaws; no card attachment or success-conditioned drive.
Remove source solid bridging mouth faces; retain actual outward wall triangles and extrude each inward by 0.6 mm into physical thin shell.
Enable articulation self-collision so nonadjacent jaws can contact.
mechanical_asset.identity_fidelity: Original CC0 binder clip geometry; flexure mechanics approximated by passive hinges
limitations: GPU contact test must verify closure, handle leverage and card retention.
Wire handles are fixed to jaws; their independent folding degree of freedom is not modeled.
Articulation starts in source open rest coordinates and closes through spring torque; released jaw gap has not yet been measured in PhysX.
Publisher source was solid art, so 0.6 mm shell thickness is an explicit adaptation; previous v1/v2 are invalid for physical clip insertion.
